title: Flying Tesla Roadster coins
summary: Coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling. Posts dated 2026-10-16 describe Tesla showing a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's Texas test site on the evening of 2026-10-15: it drove up a ramp, flipped in the air and landed, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries in 2028 (@niccruzpatane, @cb_doge, e3:1); DEXTools quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" caption and Elon Musk's reply "Turns out the future does have flying cars" (e3:0). Six coins carry the name: three Flying Tesla Roadster (FTR) contracts on Solana (one on pump.fun, two on Meteora DBC), two 特斯拉能飞 ("flying tesla roadster") coins on Robinhood Chain (Clanker) and BNB Chain (Flap), and Starman (STARMAN, "the driver of the flying Tesla Roadster"). The main pump.fun FTR says it pairs with $SPCX and $TSLA through OTC desks; its pool was created on 2026-10-15 at 02:08 UTC, about a day before the unveiling and after the reveal had been announced, while the other five pools are from the hours after it. An older FTR on StonkFun, created in August, predates the story and is not included, and two further pump.fun FTR contracts are quarantined for extreme 24h moves. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, most are hours old, and the story is a single event. Measured: six coins across all their pools.

storyStatus.interpretation: Several launch tools pitch the same mechanism, creator fees paid to a named account or person, and the sources are the tools' own pages and posts plus their users. The figures are the projects' own and payouts are not verified. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people named, or with each other.

_meta.presentationSummary: Coins whose metadata says their creator or trading fees are routed to a named person or account. UsePaid's page (usepaid.app, scraped 2026-10-13) says it routes each coin's creator fees to the X account the coin is launched for, held for that user to claim; MarsX and slopcannon say "Fees to @arikuschnir via UsePaid" and "Fees to @boneGPT via UsePaid". WORLD (pump.fun, pool from late September) says "Fees to @iammarcmalone via UsePaid"; a 2026-09-29 post says he received fees from the coin and a 2026-10-15 post says a community takeover now gives him 100% of them (e2:5). TeleMoney (TM) says it launches coins on pump.fun with fees redirected to any Telegram username, and @TeleMoneySOL posted on 2026-10-12 that 108 coins had launched, 262.8 SOL of creator fees had been generated and 17,411.2 GRAM paid out. Cashed Money (CASHED, pons on Robinhood Chain) says "Fees to @GetCashedMoney via Cashed", WIRED (Flap, BNB Chain) says token launches have fees wired to social media accounts, and Pepper The Raccoon says it redirects fees to its owner. A 2026-10-12 @PickACycle post says a pump.fun coin's fees can now be split between UsePaid, OTC desks and agencypad. The pools date from 2026-09-18 (Cashed Money) to 2026-10-12 (MarsX, about 12 hours before discovery). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and MarsX traded over 10x its market cap. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
